verdict.rationale: Missive documents an in-product AI assistant/Copilot that can compose, reply and translate messages, run long sessions, power AI rules, and draw on your internal data through custom MCP servers, so AI suggestions from your data inside the product are supported. Explicit in-product insights such as summaries or analysis of your own conversation data are not clearly documented; the inbox summarization example uses external Claude via MCP, not the in-product assistant. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-product AI insights or summaries over the user's own conversation data, any described suggestion surfaces beyond compose/reply/translate, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Quickly compose, reply, and translate messages with AI directly in Missive.
With custom MCP, you can connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI Copilot and let AI interact with your internal systems, proprietary data, or homegrown tools.
Long assistant sessions no longer need babysitting. The session tab now shows what the assistant is up to
Your AI rules, saved models, and assistant conversations stay intact
